title: Production Readiness
challenge: Pilot builds exposed recurring assembly and QA issues before production release.
role: Defined corrective-action gates, QA verification requirements and production release criteria with the Asian manufacturing team.
outcome: Production release was tied to objective verification rather than schedule pressure.

title: Supplier & DFM Review
challenge: Multiple supplier quotations used different tooling, process and MOQ assumptions, making commercial comparison difficult.
role: Normalised RFQ assumptions, challenged DFM decisions and reviewed manufacturing risk.
outcome: Created a clearer supplier-selection and commercial decision framework.

title: Program Recovery
challenge: A hardware program was losing time through slow supplier communication, unclear ownership and unresolved technical actions.
role: Introduced action ownership, decision gates and structured supplier follow-up.
outcome: Reduced ambiguity and created a clearer path toward the next build milestone.
